text: And Jehovah{H3068} called{H7121} unto Moses,{H4872} and spake{H1696} unto him out of the tent{H168} of meeting,{H4150} saying,{H559}

Speak{H1696} unto the children{H1121} of Israel,{H3478} and say{H559} unto them, When any man{H120} of you offereth{H7126} an oblation{H7133} unto Jehovah,{H3068} ye shall offer{H7126} your oblation{H7133} of the cattle,{H929} [even] of the herd{H1241} and of the flock.{H6629}

If his oblation{H7133} be a burnt-offering{H7133} of the herd,{H1241} he shall offer{H7126} it a male{H2145} without blemish:{H8549} he shall{H7522} offer{H7126} it at the door{H6607} of the tent{H168} of meeting,{H4150} that he may be accepted before{H6440} Jehovah.{H3068}
And he shall lay{H5564} his hand{H3027} upon the head{H7218} of the burnt-offering;{H5930} and it shall be accepted{H7521} for him to make atonement{H3722} for him.

And he shall kill{H7819} the bullock{H1121} before{H6440} Jehovah:{H3068} and Aaron's{H175} sons,{H1121} the priests,{H3548} shall present{H7126} the blood,{H1818} and sprinkle{H2236} the blood{H1818} round about{H5439} upon the altar{H4196} that is at the door{H6607} of the tent{H168} of meeting.{H4150}
And he shall flay{H6584} the burnt-offering,{H5930} and cut{H5408} it into its pieces.{H5409}
And the sons{H1121} of Aaron{H175} the priest{H3548} shall put{H5414} fire{H784} upon the altar,{H4196} and lay wood{H6086} in order{H6186} upon the fire;{H784}

and Aaron's{H175} sons,{H1121} the priests,{H3548} shall lay{H6186} the pieces, the head,{H7218} and the fat,{H6309} in order{H6186} upon the wood{H6086} that is on the fire{H784} which is upon the altar:{H4196}

but its inwards{H7130} and its legs{H3767} shall he wash{H7364} with water.{H4325} And the priest{H3548} shall burn{H6999} the whole on the altar,{H4196} for a burnt-offering,{H5930} an offering made by fire,{H801} of a sweet{H5207} savor{H7381} unto Jehovah.{H3068}
And if his oblation{H7133} be of the flock,{H6629} of the sheep,{H3775} or of the goats,{H5795} for a burnt-offering;{H5930} he shall offer{H7126} it a male{H2145} without blemish.{H8549}

And he shall kill{H7819} it on the side{H3409} of the altar{H4196} northward{H6828} before{H6440} Jehovah:{H3068} and Aaron's{H175} sons,{H1121} the priests,{H3548} shall sprinkle{H2236} its blood{H1818} upon the altar{H4196} round about.{H5439}

And he shall cut{H5408} it into its pieces,{H5409} with its head{H7218} and its fat;{H6309} and the priest{H3548} shall lay them in order{H6186} on the wood{H6086} that is on the fire{H784} which is upon the altar:{H4196}

but the inwards{H7130} and the legs{H3767} shall he wash{H7364} with water.{H4325} And the priest{H3548} shall offer{H7126} the whole, and burn{H6999} it upon the altar:{H4196} it is a burnt-offering,{H5930} an offering made by fire,{H801} of a sweet{H5207} savor{H7381} unto Jehovah.{H3068}
And if his oblation{H7133} to Jehovah{H3068} be a burnt-offering{H5930} of birds,{H5775} then he shall offer{H7126} his oblation{H7133} of turtle-doves,{H8449} or of young{H1121} pigeons.{H3123}

And the priest{H3548} shall bring{H7126} it unto the altar,{H4196} and wring off{H4454} its head,{H7218} and burn{H6999} it on the altar;{H4196} and the blood{H1818} thereof shall be drained out{H4680} on the side{H7023} of the altar;{H4196}
and he shall take away{H5493} its crop{H4760} with the filth{H5133} thereof, and cast{H7993} it beside{H681} the altar{H4196} on the east part,{H6924} in the place{H4725} of the ashes:{H1880}

and he shall rend{H8156} it by the wings{H3671} thereof, [but] shall not divide it asunder.{H914} And the priest{H3548} shall burn{H6999} it upon the altar,{H4196} upon the wood{H6086} that is upon the fire:{H784} it is a burnt-offering,{H5930} an offering made by fire,{H801} of a sweet{H5207} savor{H7381} unto Jehovah.{H3068}
